title: Fact node
description: The envelope every fact node shares: id, type, name, source URL, measuredAt, attrs (verdict, fetched_at, quote, and an optional basis and status) and edges. A domain schema references this one and declares only its type values. That every edge target exists is checked by the graph checker, not by this schema.

type.description: One of the type values the domain schema declares.

source.description: Where the fact was read: the official page for a documented fact, or the run or record that measured it for an observed one. The quote is on this page or in this record.

measuredAt.description: The date the fact was last confirmed: a real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

verdict.description: allowed, denied or limited: what the page states. unknown: it could not be confirmed. absent: the page was checked and does not state it; note names the page checked and quote is its nearest sentence, and there is no value.

fetched_at.description: When the page was read, or for an observed fact when the measurement ran. UTC, a real calendar date and time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ, optional fraction of a second; RFC 3339 allows a lower-case t).

quote.description: A short sentence copied exactly from the page, or for an observed fact a line copied exactly from the run log or record.

basis.description: Where the number comes from: documented (the vendor states it) or observed (our own measurement). Absent means documented. A documented node and an observed node about the same quantity stay two nodes, linked by an observes edge from the observed one. A node with an observes edge must say basis observed.

value.description: A number only; its meaning is carried by unit, scope and window.

note.description: Prose that does not fit value, unit, scope or window.

status.description: Optional, for a fact that is a rule with a legal or published state: in-force (it applies now), notified-not-in-force (published, with a later start), draft (proposed, not adopted) or superseded (replaced by a later rule). Absent means the domain does not track it. A domain schema may narrow the list or forbid status, never add a value.

rel.description: The first eleven relate product facts. The last six relate legal texts: issuedBy: an instrument to the authority that issued it. partOf: a provision to its instrument. madeUnder: rules or directions to the enabling provision. imposes: a provision to the obligation, timeline, penalty or exemption it creates. amends: an instrument to the instrument it amends. commencedBy: a provision to the notification that brought it into force. A domain schema may restrict rel to the values it uses.
